Hi friends! The holiday season is officially here! Wow that came fast. Since spooky season is over, I'm giving a little love to Fall's most thankful holiday... with a Thanksgiving-sized helping of true crime. 

In this special MMM compilation, I'm serving up three grisly stories where food, football, and family all lead to destruction.

First, we carve into the story of the "Fast Food Killer," Paul Dennis Reid, whose 60-day rampage left people wondering: mentally unwell or just plain evil? 

Then, we put on our jerseys for the shocking story of NFL star Aaron Hernandez, a man who had it all until the darkness (and a tragic case of CTE) caught up to him. 

Finally, we ruin Christmas a little bit early with the story of the Covina Christmas Massacre and a very, very bad Santa with a flamethrower.

Pop this on while you're prepping your holiday feast, decorating for Christmas, or while you settle into your turkey coma.
